final_gold_set_description: 230 pairs: 77 pass-2 blind labels carried from gold-v2.jsonl plus 153 pass-3 blind re-review labels. Totals same 96, different 131, unsure 3. No label was made with a suggestion visible. Known limitation: pass 3 median gap 0.6 s; the human reports 12 clear-non-match pairs labeled same are likely labeling errors (see gold-v3-evaluation-record.md). Labels were not corrected after seeing matcher output.

export.policy: scholarchain.er.policy/1.1.0 for eval, eval-v2 and eval-v3; scholarchain.er.policy/1.2.0 for eval-v3-after; scholarchain.er.policy/1.3.0 for eval-v3-r2; scholarchain.er.policy/1.4.0 for eval-v3-r3, which makes an agreeing ORCID on two slots of the same work record a CONFLICT with or without a DOI or arXiv id (same thresholds: accept 0.95, reject 0.35, adjudication band [0.70, 0.95); 1.2.0 adds the same-DOI differing-author-position rule; 1.3.0 extends it to a shared arXiv id and makes an agreeing ORCID or content-supported aggregator ID that coincides with the position rule a CONFLICT); thresholds provisional, not tuned on this set
